title: Good: @ check in is_valid_fetch_host placed before all parsing
description: The host.contains('@') check is placed immediately after the is_empty() check, before any bracket stripping, colon counting, or port parsing. This is correct: no subsequent transformation in the function can introduce '@', so a single early check is sufficient and cannot be bypassed. A contributor might be tempted to move the check later (e.g. after bracket stripping) or to only check in specific branches — both would be wrong. The early placement is the correct design.
